post.description:
`recorded_at` is server time; the phone's `at` only orders fixes from the same phone. A fix
more than 200 m from the previous one within 3 s is a GPS jump and is dropped.

`payment.captured` → the same idempotent `mark_paid` as verify; event ids are deduped, so
a replay is a no-op. `payment.failed` changes nothing (the order expires at 15 min).
